sections.title: Overtime working time
sections.content: (1) An employer may not require or permit an employee to work overtime except in accordance with an agreement and within the limits prescribed.

sections.title: Annual leave
sections.content: An employee is entitled to not less than 21 consecutive days annual leave on full remuneration in respect of each annual leave cycle.

sections.title: Notice period
sections.content: Notice of termination of employment given by an employer must be at least one week if the employee has been employed for six months or less.

sections.title: Severance pay
sections.content: An employer must pay severance pay equal to one week's remuneration for each completed year of continuous service.

sections.title: Director duties - good faith
sections.content: A director must act in good faith in the best interests of the company.
